I am a data scientist and researcher working at the intersection of 
spectroscopy, chemometrics, and applied machine learning. Currently 
Head of Data Science at [BUCHI Labortechnik AG](https://www.buchi.com/en), 
Switzerland. PhD from the University of Tübingen, postdoctoral research 
at ETH Zürich, and MSc in Business Analytics from Imperial College London.
